faq.q: What does Amazon require for the main image?
faq.a: Use a pure white backdrop, let the product fill most of the square, and leave off text, badges and props. Confirm the live rule in Seller Central before you publish.

faq.q: What happens if an image does not meet the rules?
faq.a: Amazon can suppress that image, and the listing can drop out of search until you replace it. Keep the main image plain, and put callouts only on later gallery images.

faq.q: Can I make a white main from a regular photo?
faq.a: Yes. Upload a clear product photo and choose the plain main. The item is placed on an empty backdrop. You do not book a studio for that frame. The walkthrough is in [Amazon white background photo](/guides/white-background-amazon).

faq.q: Can I process a whole catalog in one job?
faq.a: No. Each file is its own job from one upload, and the credit cost shows before that job.

faq.q: Which images should follow the main image?
faq.a: A tight detail, a size cue, and an in-use view. Each one should answer the shopper's next question.
Add them yourself after download, and only on images after the main. The main image stays free of badges and slogans.

faq.q: Can I make a video for the listing?
faq.a: Yes, as a separate job of 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds. Check the current Sponsored Brands and product-video rules before you use it. A still is 24 credits.

faq.q: Will you upload the photos to Amazon for me?
faq.a: No. Download the file and add it in Seller Central yourself. We do not connect a seller account, and we do not send the gallery for you.
